tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal sa skya'i dgon pa nas/ rigs dang yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchims jo sras chos kyi seng ge'i phyag tu spring ba/ rje btsun sgrol ma zhi ma 'am khro mo gang rung yan lag bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ yang bla ma dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su spyan drangs/ yid mchod ci 'byor pa tsam gyis mchod/ mos gus drag po byas te spyi bo nas mar bstim/ des rkyen byas nas bdag gi gnas kyi lha rnams gsal gdab par bya ste/ spyi bo pullī ra mā la yar myur zhing dpa' mo gsal gdab/ de bzhin du spyi gtsug dzā landha rar ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ rna ba g.yas au rgyan du gser gyi mdog can ma/ ltag pa arbu tar gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma/ rna ba g.yon go dā wa rīr hūm̐ gi sgra sgrogs ma/ smin ma'i dbus rā me shwa rīr sku'i sgrol ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mig gnyis de wī ko ṭar 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma/ dpung pa gnyis mā la war gzhan 'joms ma/ mchan khung kā ma rū par bdud thams cad 'joms shing dbang mchog ster ma/ nu ma o trer 'khor los sgyur ba 'dod pa rab tu sbyin ma/ lte ba tri sha ku ner mya ngan thams cad sel bar byed ma/ sna rtse kos lar 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing phongs pa sel ma/ kha ka liṅgār bkra shis thams cad sbyin ma/ mgrin pa laṃ pā kār gsung gi sgrol ma dmar mo padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snying kāñtsir thugs kyi sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'dom par hi mā la yar yongs su smin byed ma/ rtags kyi rtse mo pre ta pu rir 'gugs pa'i khro mo/ bshang lam gra ha de war zhi ba chen mo/

brla gnyis sau rāṣṭar chags pa 'joms ma/ byin pa gnyis su warṇa dwī par bde ba thams cad sgrub ma/ sor mo bcu drug na ga rar rnam par rgyal ma bcu drug ste skad cig gis gsal gdab/ gzhan rnams dran pa tsam bya/ bol gnyis sindhur sdug bsngal thams cad sreg ma/ rkang lag gi mthe bong bzhi ma ror dngos grub thams cad 'byung ma/ pus mo ku luntar yongs su rdzogs par byed ma ste de rnams gsal btab nas/ de ltar lha mo nyi shu rtsa gcig gi steng du sku gsung thugs kyi lha mo rnams kyi bsnan pas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o// de rnams la yul nyer bzhi/ de dag la yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ sor mo so sor phye na lnga bcu tham par 'gro/ de rnams su lha lnga bcu tham pa bsgom/ de'ang yul mang ba rnams ni lha re re gsal btab la/ gzhan rnams ni dran pa tsam bya/ yang yid kyis ye shes pa cig spyan drangs la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa dran pa tsam bya/ yid mchod ci 'byor pas mchod la bstod pa 'don pa dang*/ khro mo'am zhi ba'i sngags bzla bar bya'o// de lta bu'i bsnyen pa rdzogs nas las thams cad 'di kho nas 'grub bo// rje btsun ma thams cad kyi spyi sgrub lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa bstan zin to// dpal sa skya nas theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ mchims jo sras rigs gzugs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa chos kyi seng ge la spring ba'o// ha la sa ti hi la sogs pa dang*/ ho ri ha sha la sogs pa dang*/ so shad kyi slob ma rgan po rnams kyi brjed byang lta bu'i zin ris mchan du bcug pa yin pas/ de dag la dgos pa ma mchis/ rab gnas kyi lha mo'i sa bon lags/ spyir 'di rnams kyi sa bon lugs gsum ste/ rang rang gi yig sna'am/ mchan bzhin bya ba'am/ yi ge bcu pa lan gnyis ldabs nas tha ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sa bon oṃ gyis byed/

mdor na yi ge nyi shu rtsa gcig gis byed de/ de ltar lugs gnyis las phyi ma 'di gtso bo yin no// slad mar da dung dgos pa bdog na yi ge bris shing skur mdzod/ thugs dgongs legs par bskang lags/ gzhung gi sngags mchan med pa ku ru kulle hrīḥ zhes pa la sogs pa lta bu gzungs kyi tshig ces bya ba las/ bshad na mtha' yas par 'gyur mod/ bod skad thad sor bsgyur du mi btub lags/ mchan med pa rnams kyi thad sor de skad gsung bar zhu/ sarbārtha siddhi bha wantu/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
